2025_firewall.final_evaluation: frozen recipe ONLY, applied to frozen 2025 base predictions; reported as PREVIOUSLY REVEALED OUT-OF-TIME ENSEMBLE EVALUATION
2025_firewall.mechanism: development-only resolver + season assertions + ProtectedHoldoutError reuse + artifact scan + tests proving 2025 inaccessible from selection functions

2025_historical_context.usage: static documentation ONLY; must not enter selection code

2025_status: PREVIOUSLY REVEALED OUT-OF-TIME EVALUATION SET (NOT an untouched holdout; individual-model results observed in V3.3)

calibrated_blend.status: EXCLUDED (no distinct scientific justification; not a candidate slot)

logistic_stacker.form: logit(P(Y=1)) = b0 + b1 * logit_clip(p_logistic) + b2 * logit_clip(p_xgb)
logistic_stacker.regularization: L2 fixed C=1.0 (no C search; 2-input, large history sample; fixed beats searched for leakage surface)

advancement_rules.KEEP_ENSEMBLE_PRIMARY: credible primary-LL gain + bootstrap support + temporal consistency + no probability-quality regression
advancement_rules.KEEP_ENSEMBLE_TIE_BREAK: parity on primary with robustness/ simplicity justification
advancement_rules.REJECT_COMPLEXITY_WITHOUT_VALUE: stacker adds nothing over best blend
advancement_rules.REJECT_NO_IMPROVEMENT: no credible pre-2025 gain over Logistic
advancement_rules.REJECT_TEMPORAL_INSTABILITY: gains concentrated in one fold, absent elsewhere

base_prediction_contract.identity_join: state_id only; row-position joins forbidden (V3.3 row-order incident invariant)
base_prediction_contract.semantics: RAW INDEPENDENT_BINARY probabilities in [0, 1]; same arm/hash for both streams

blend_grid_policy.adaptive_refinement: FORBIDDEN (no finer grid after B results)
blend_grid_policy.resolution: 0.1 (identify whether small XGB contribution helps; not arbitrary weight optimization)

calibration_policy.ensemble_output: RAW (option A: simplicity; bases RAW and near-baseline calibrated; no predeclared reason)

compute_budget.expectation: minutes (base predictions exist; blends seconds; 2-input stacker cheap)

D1.learned_params: NOT_EVALUABLE (no prior OOF history); baseline-only fallback for stacker scoring

excluded_methods.mc2_fusion: belongs to V3.8 (model x simulation consensus)
excluded_methods.subgroup_weights: race/driver/team/stage/track/season-specific or per-race-optimized weights forbidden (limited race-level sample; overfitting risk)

final_recipe_policy.cardinality: exactly one of NO_ENSEMBLE | one ensemble recipe

known_limitations: 2025 already revealed for base models; V3.4 cannot claim pristine holdout
68-race development history; race-level sample still limited
D1 has no prior OOF history: learned params NOT_EVALUABLE there
two-model linear opinion pool cannot capture interactions
single fixed stacker C: no regularization search by design

null_result_policy.rule: no credible pre-2025 improvement over Logistic -> NO_ENSEMBLE; V3.1B remains champion; no 2025 ensemble fishing; no forced V3.4E; proceed to V3.5

robustness_policy.neighbor_check: winning w inspected at neighboring grid points (+/-0.1); isolated spike = weak evidence vs broad useful region

scientific_question: Does XGBoost contain complementary predictive information that can be combined with the frozen V3.1B Logistic model to improve winner probability quality over Logistic alone? The burden of proof is on the ensemble. A null result is acceptable.

stacker_contract.forbidden: outer-validation labels for coefficients; 2025 anywhere in training/selection
stacker_contract.training_data: earlier-fold OOF prediction history only (D2 stacker from D1; D3 stacker from D1+D2; D1 NOT_EVALUABLE)

stage_plan.V3.4A: Ensemble Landscape + Experiment Contract (this stage; no fitting)
stage_plan.V3.4B: Development Ensemble Experiments (grid evaluation + expanding-window stacker; stop: no 2025 contact)
stage_plan.V3.4C: Controlled Selection + Robustness (one recipe or NO_ENSEMBLE; stop: recipe frozen before any 2025 use)
stage_plan.V3.4D: Final Recipe Freeze (machine-readable recipe; stop: frozen recipe immutable)
stage_plan.V3.4E: Previously Revealed 2025 Ensemble Evaluation, ONLY if an ensemble survives (stop: report as revealed, not holdout)

temporal_protocol.d1_handling: fixed blends evaluated descriptively; learned stacker NOT_EVALUABLE, baseline-only fallback
temporal_protocol.design: evaluate whole preregistered fixed grid on D1/D2/D3 (pure evaluation, no fitting: temporally safe); select ONE final recipe only after all folds in V3.4C under predeclared advancement rules
temporal_protocol.outer_validation_selects: NOTHING (no weights, coefficients, regularization, or calibration)

test_policy: tests/test_v3_4a_contract.py + V3.3F integrity + relevant V3.3 alignment/metric tests; FULL_TIER1 = NOT_REQUIRED_CONTRACT_ONLY

conclusions.xgboost: KEEP_DIVERSITY_CANDIDATE (V3.4 eligible; does NOT replace V3.1B standalone)
